Experience the mesmerizing magic of this cameo performance by the legendary Bamboo Flautist, Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia, recorded live at the Royal Festival Hall in London in October 1994.
Accompanying him are the renowned claypot maestro, Vikku Vinayakram, and the tabla virtuoso, Sukhwinder Singh Namdhari. Together, they create a captivating blend of sounds that transport listeners to the serene world of Raga Bageshri.
